## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally (typecheck + lint + tests + compile)
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `src/core` and `src/application` stay free of `vscode` imports
- [ ] Public behavior changes are reflected in `README` / `docs/user-guide.md`
- [ ] Architecturally significant decisions get an ADR under `docs/adr/`
